title: Help centre
subtitle: Answers to the questions members ask most

blocks.question: How do I open an account?
blocks.text: Choose Register at the top of any page, fill in your details and confirm your email address. We verify new accounts within one working day.

blocks.question: I forgot my password. What now?
blocks.text: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page. We email you a link that works for one hour.

blocks.question: How do I change my email address?
blocks.text: Go to Profile › Contact and choose Change. We send a code to the new address to confirm it.
We will never ask for your password by email or phone.

blocks.question: Can I turn on two-step sign-in?
blocks.text: Yes. Go to Profile › Security and choose Turn on two-step sign-in. You will need a phone with an authenticator app.
Bids are binding: the highest bid when the auction closes wins the lot.

blocks.question: Can I withdraw a bid?
blocks.text: No. A bid is a promise to buy. Contact us at once if you made a mistake.

blocks.question: What is a deposit, and when do I get it back?
blocks.text:
A deposit shows you are serious about a lot. We hold it until the auction closes.
If you do not win, we return it within three working days.

blocks.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
Are there any fees?
blocks.text: The fees for each lot are listed with it.

Method | Fee | Arrives in
Bank transfer | None | 1 working day
Card | 1.5% | At once
